headline: Mexico Trade Surplus With US Reaches Record $184 Billion in Nine Months
summary: Mexico's trade surplus with the United States rose 26% in the first nine months of 2026 to a record $184 billion, driven largely by demand for IT equipment.
why: Bilateral trade balances highlight supply chain integration and manufacturing demand between major North American economies.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: A widening trade surplus indicates robust export revenue growth.
